facets.description: `true` to also answer what each filter can take, counted.

limit.description: Battles per page, 20 by default, 100 at most.

map.description: Only battles on this arena, by the game's own map id (`05_prohorovka`). `facets.maps` lists the ones the catalogue has.

mode.description: Only battles of this mode, by the game's own `bonusType` (1 is random battles). `facets.modes` lists the ones the catalogue has.

page.description: Which page of `limit` battles, counted from one. The first by default; `total` in the answer says how many there are.

result.description: Only replays whose recorder won, lost or drew.

sort.description: What the replays are ranked by: the damage their recorder dealt (`damage`, the default), their assisted damage, experience or kills, the newest first (`recent`), or the most opened (`views`) or downloaded (`downloads`).

tank.description: Only replays recorded in this vehicle, by its tank id. `facets.tanks` lists the ones the catalogue has.

version.description: Only battles of this game update, as `2.4.1` (any hotfix of it), or `latest` for the newest update the catalogue holds. `versions` lists the ones it has.
